title: Instacart Order Order Total Leaderboard
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=instacart:order order_total_usd=*
| stats sum(order_total_usd) as total_value, avg(order_total_usd) as avg_value by store_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks store values by total and average order total across Instacart order events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `order_total_usd` values for each Instacart order event and review total and average order total by store.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total order total.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which store shows the biggest order total numbers in your Instacart order data.
